summary: Iter-33 — RE-VERIFIED the 402 upgrade-CTA frontend flow after main agent's api.js response-interceptor fix. ALL 5 review-request scenarios pass end-to-end. The interceptor now narrows the stringify mutation to Array.isArray(d) only (lines 222-232 of /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js), preserves the raw object dict on err.response.data.detail, and stashes arrays at err.response.data._rawDetail. PendingTransfersBanner.accept() now correctly receives detail.code='plan_upgrade_required' on 402, surfaces the inline upgrade card + CTA, and the CTA navigates to /app/billing?subscribe=temper (Temper $300/mo confirm modal auto-opens). After mock-upgrading the user to 'temper' plan, re-clicking Accept transfers ownership cleanly: offer disappears, success toast renders, GET /api/orgs/{id} returns role='owner'. No React 'Objects are not valid as a child' errors anywhere. The interceptor fix is correct and complete.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js interceptor fix (lines 222-232) is correct: Array.isArray(d) guard correctly narrows to Pydantic validation arrays only, leaving HTTPException(detail={...}) object dicts untouched for callers like PendingTransfersBanner that branch on detail.code. The _rawDetail stash for arrays is a nice defensive courtesy for any future caller that needs the original array.
errorMessage() helper at lines 247-264 unchanged and still handles string, array, and single-object detail shapes — keeps existing toast.error sites working without any migration.
